note: African regional and continental reference corpus (public documents), used by the readiness engine as the external benchmark a national corpus is compared against. Only continental and regional instruments are listed here: national strategies of individual countries are deliberately excluded, so the benchmark never depends on another jurisdiction's policy choices. The PDFs are large and stay out of git (see scripts/fetch-corpus.sh); the manifest itself is versioned.
rightsNote: Per-document rights status. official-text = official legislative/administrative/judicial text, generally outside copyright under Cameroonian law; open-licence = explicit reuse licence (see the entry); quotation-only = third-party work, short attributed quotations only, payload not redistributed; to-confirm = rights not established, do not publish the payload. Third-party payloads are git-ignored; only manifests (and the project's own samples) are versioned. See docs/LICENSING.md.
